params.name: Rillbend Orchard Path
params.description: A narrow public footpath beyond Thistlebell Yard, threading between old apple orchards and a shallow drainage rill. Moss-dark stone culverts carry rainwater beneath the trail; a wooden handrail crosses the lowest bend.
params.culture: Asterwyn Orchard Vales; walkers share the path with farm workers, orchard carts on the nearby road and seasonal beasts passing through hedgerows.
